units.source_text: 朱雀院又恳托承香殿女御善意照拂三公主。

en.t: Retired Emperor Suzaku also earnestly asked the Shokyoden Consort to look after the Third Princess with kindness.

units.source_text: 然而当三公主的母亲藤壶女御独占恩宠之时，其他更衣和女御皆曾与她争宠。

en.t: However, when the Third Princess's mother, the Fujitsubo Consort, had monopolized the emperor's favor, the other ladies and consorts had all competed with her for his affection.

units.source_text: 因此承香殿女御和藤壶女御并不亲睦。

en.t: For that reason, the Shokyoden Consort and the Fujitsubo Consort were not on friendly terms.

units.source_text: 照此推量起来，承香殿女御旧怨未消，即使不甚厌恶这三公主，亦未必能真心诚意地照拂她吧。

en.t: Judging from this, the Shokyoden Consort's old resentment had not faded, and even if she did not greatly dislike the Third Princess, she was unlikely to be able to care for her with true sincerity.

units.source_text: 朱雀院为了三公主之事，朝夕愁叹。

en.t: Retired Emperor Suzaku grieved and sighed morning and evening over the matter of the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 到了年底，病势更加沉重，帘外也不能出来了。

en.t: By the end of the year, his illness had grown still more serious, and he could no longer even come out beyond the curtains.

units.source_text: 以前他也常常为了鬼魂作祟而患病，

en.t: In the past, too, he had often fallen ill because of possessing spirits,

units.source_text: 然而这鬼魂从来不曾像此次那样缠绕不休，

en.t: but never before had such a spirit clung to him as relentlessly as it did this time,
and so he suspected that his final hour had come.

units.source_text: 他虽然早已让位，但在位时受他恩泽的人，

en.t: Although he had long since abdicated, those who had received his favor while he was on the throne

units.source_text: 现在还同从前一样亲近他，

en.t: still remained close to him now, just as they had before,

units.source_text: 以一仰仁慈的御颜为衷心慰藉，时时前来参谒。

en.t: taking heartfelt comfort in even one glimpse of his compassionate face, and coming from time to time to pay their respects.

units.source_text: 这些人闻知朱雀院身患重病，无不真心担忧。

en.t: When these people heard that Retired Emperor Suzaku was gravely ill, every one of them was sincerely worried.
